note: Descriptions are each KB's own verbatim domain_label + purpose — not rewritten. The 84 dense KBs are the subdomain grounding distilled into the 28 specialists.

kbs.purpose: Provide a session-bounded, evaluable decision ontology for adopting and trusting LLMs/AI appropriately: choosing when (not) to use an LLM, selecting prompt/RAG/fine-tune/tools, knowing failure modes (hallucination, brittleness, bias, context/cutoff limits, overconfidence), interpreting evaluation, and applying safety and governance basics.

Machine-readable conceptual-computing-literacy ontology of evaluable explanatory/decision work-units that let a non-specialist reason correctly about how computers actually work (hardware and data representation: binary/bits/bytes/encodings, CPU execution, memory hierarchy, storage; software layers: operating systems, processes/threads, compilers vs interpreters, networking; algorithms and data structures: arrays, hash maps, trees, sorting/searching; and complexity: Big-O, tractability, recursion, time/space tradeoffs), oriented to understanding rather than building, as a subdomain node of Computing & How LLMs Work (Foundations) within a knowledge-searcher meta-KB that routes each concept to authoritative sources, verifies explanations against them, and synthesizes one coherent layered mental model.

machine-readable ontology for understanding-level explanation of how large language models work as concrete explanatory work-units: representation (tokenization, embeddings, vectors, similarity, sequence/position), the transformer (self-attention, layers, next-token prediction, context window), learning phases (pretraining, supervised fine-tuning, preference tuning and what each changes), inference (sampling/decoding, prompting/in-context learning, retrieval-augmented generation), an end-to-end inference trace, and the intrinsic limits, scaling, evaluation, interpretability, and behavioral-alignment caveats that follow; a subdomain node of Computing & How LLMs Work (Foundations) for a knowledge-searcher meta-KB, kept at literacy altitude with the engineering of building/fine-tuning/orchestrating LLM systems deferred to a sibling subdomain.
